answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use time-locked reputation escrow: each new agent parks a refundable stake that unlocks slowly as verified peers rate its work. In the delta between a fresh identity and a veteran, only the veteran can underwrite others, so an attacker planting a whole lagoon of fake agents waits months for unlockable escrow — turning the fable of cheap fake accounts into an expensive, illiquid bond that never pays back.
